key_claims: Nicotinamide riboside supplementation and high-intensity exercise training have divergent effects on skeletal muscle epigenetic aging.
The study was published in Aging Cell, Volume 25, Issue 8, August 2026.
The research focuses on the effects of these interventions on skeletal muscle.
limitations: The source is a journal article reference without detailed methodology or results.

The study's design and sample size are not described.
